2610.06248.title: From Papers to Mechanisms: An Evidence-Grounded Knowledge Substrate for Scientific Language Models
2610.06248.paper_summary: Scientific language models often access literature through untyped text chunks, which fragment the functional and evidential structure required for mechanism-rich questions. We introduce an evidence-grounded mechanism knowledge substrate that organizes scientific literature into provenance-linked evidence units, role-typed entities, and directed mechanism paths. We instantiate it as MS$^3$, a Material-Sensor-Signal-System schema for conductive-fiber flexible sensors, over 13,689 papers, 131,083 evidence items, and 26,648 mechanism objects. On in-domain and coverage-shift question-answering benchmarks, we compare closed-book generation, Web search, Raw-PDF RAG, and MS$^3$ retrieval across ten language models. MS$^3$ improves macro-averaged scientific correctness. It also improves citation entailment and answer completeness. These results support mechanism substrates as a reliable representation layer for scientific language models and motivate a source-repair workflow in which insufficient MS$^3$ evidence triggers targeted retrieval from its linked papers rather than assuming that a user has already supplied the correct PDFs.
2610.06248.paper_summary_zh: 科學語言模型通常通過未類型化的文本片段訪問文獻，這會破壞機制豐富問題所需的功能和證據結構。我們引入了一種基於證據的機制知識基底，將科學文獻組織成來源鏈接的證據單元、角色類型的實體和有向機制路徑。我們將其具體化為 MS$^3$，一種用於導電纖維柔性傳感器的材料-傳感器-信號-系統架構，涵蓋 13,689 篇論文、131,083 個證據項和 26,648 個機制對象。在領域內和覆蓋轉移的問題回答基準上，我們比較了閉卷生成、網絡搜索、原始 PDF RAG 和 MS$^3$ 檢索在十個語言模型中的表現。MS$^3$ 改進了宏觀平均的科學正確性。它還改善了引用推導和答案完整性。這些結果支持機制基底作為科學語言模型的可靠表示層，並激勵了一種源修復工作流程，其中不足的 MS$^3$ 證據觸發從其鏈接的論文中進行針對性檢索，而不是假設用戶已經提供了正確的 PDF。
